Package org.cyborgcats.vision

Record Class AprilTagTarget

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.cyborgcats.vision.AprilTagTarget
Record Components:
aprilTag - the detected tag's known field ID and pose
corners - detected image-space corners of this tag
yaw - horizontal angle from the camera to the tag, in degrees
pitch - vertical angle from the camera to the tag, in degrees
area - on-screen area of this tag, as a fraction of the image area
skew - skew of the detected tag quad
bestCameraToTag - transform from camera to tag for the best pose candidate
altCameraToTag - transform from camera to tag for the alternate pose candidate
bestError - reprojection error of the best pose candidate
altError - reprojection error of the alternate pose candidate
public record AprilTagTarget(AprilTag aprilTag, ArrayList<org.opencv.core.Point> corners, double yaw, double pitch, double area, double skew, Transform3d bestCameraToTag, Transform3d altCameraToTag, double bestError, double altError) extends Record
Per-tag detail for a single AprilTag that contributed to an AprilTagEstimate: its known field pose, detected image corners, angular offsets, and both pose-solve candidates for this tag alone.

    • from

      public static Optional<AprilTagTarget> from(AprilTagEstimatorJNI.Target target)
      Converts a raw JNI target into this higher-level type, resolving its fiducial ID against the field layout and unpacking its flat corner array into Points.
      Parameters:
      target - the raw JNI target to convert
      Returns:
      empty if target's ID isn't in the field layout (the native solve may still include such a target even when it didn't contribute to the pose estimate)

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
